meta.homeDescription: Search products, HSN codes and IS standards. Certko maps BIS, BEE, GMARK, CE, FCC, SABER, WPC and the labs that unlock them.

home.title: Find the right certification and testing for your product
home.subtitle: Type a product name, IS standard or HSN. We’ll show the schemes that usually apply — BIS, BEE, GMARK, CE, FCC, SABER, WPC — plus the tests, labs and ballpark costs so you know what to book next.
home.needTitle: What do you need for this product?
home.step1Body: Start with a product name, IS standard or HSN code. Certko maps the certification and testing routes that usually apply.
home.step2Body: Compare BIS, BEE, GMARK, CE, FCC, SABER, WPC and more — with scheme notes so you know what is mandatory vs buyer-driven.
home.step3Body: See indicative lab charges, recognised laboratories and what to book next. Hand the rest to an expert when you are ready.
